def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    people_patches = image_patch.find("people")
    if not people_patches: return image_patch
    
    # Calculate the center of the paved area
    paved_area_center_x = image.shape[1] / 2
    paved_area_center_y = image.shape[0] / 2
    
    # Sort people by their distance from the center of the paved area
    people_patches.sort(key=lambda p: (p.horizontal_center - paved_area_center_x)**2 + (p.vertical_center - paved_area_center_y)**2)
    
    # Select the people closest to the center
    return people_patches[:min(len(people_patches), 5)]  # Adjust the number of people as needed
